name: ATSB 2013 presentation matrix (reference preset)
status: REFERENCE ONLY. Transcribed by hand from slides 10-12 and 22 of the source below. Not the matrix of any specific organisation: an operator or regulator may use a 4x4 version whose top-right cell is 2,500. Confirm against your organisation's own matrix before using any score for decisions.

source.title: Event Risk Classification (ERC) — Finding out where the problems really lie
source.author: Russell Taylor, Australian Transport Safety Bureau (ATSB)
source.method: ERC is from the ARMS (Aviation Risk Management Solutions) working group. Step 1 = most credible accident outcome; Step 2 = effectiveness of remaining barriers; Step 3 = score from the matrix. It is an analyst judgement, not a computed value.

columns.definition: An abnormal situation, more demanding to manage, but still a considerable safety margin
An accident was not avoided, or was avoided by luck

rows.outcome: 1 or more injuries (no fatalities), minor damage to aircraft
No potential for aircraft damage or injuries
